title: The Girl Who Wanted to Be a Maid
overview: Luciana Rudleberg, the count's daughter, was a huge mess until one maid named Melody came to accept the job.

title: At This Moment, a Maid's Superiority Is About to Unfold
overview: Getting used to her new job, Melody goes to town to gather food, when she runs into another maid.

title: Two Girls Proceed to the Royal Castle
overview: Melody finds an escort for Luciana, but she ends up going herself?! With her father there, what will she do?

title: The Truth Beneath the Moonlight
overview: Things begin to heat up as Luciana starts sensing malicious gazes from people at the ball, but who and why?

title: Sudden Seriousness
overview: With Melody away from the castle, will Christopher and Anna-Marie be able to save Luciana from the Dark One?!

title: The House of Rudleberg's All-Works Maid
overview: As the scenario continues to change, Anna-Marie makes it her mission to find out the cause only to find out...

title: Anna-Marie's Exciting Day-Off Date
overview: After learning of her mistake, Anna-Marie decides to take a breather by secretly heading to town, when...

title: A New Encounter at the Royal Academy
overview: First day of school is finally here. Having a mixed reputation, will Luciana and Melody make any friends?

title: A Knight's Reunion and the Wavering Pride of a Maid
overview: While Luciana's school life appears to be going well, Melody finds herself bored as she questions her purpose.

title: The Jealous Witch Incident
overview: With events derailing from the game, the reincarnators try to gather clues to see who the Jealous Witch is.

title: The Choice the Ladies Make
overview: Students begin to accuse Luciana, as another incident occurs. Will they manage to find the jealous witch?
